scope: Fixed PyPI Django 5.2.6 dependency note and only CVE-2025-57833 / CVE-2025-59681. A historical two-alert metadata check, not a recommendation of a currently safe version, security scan, exploitability test, exhaustive coverage or freshness benchmark.
configuration: OpenCode 1.18.35; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash / high; execution: 25 model requests / 600 s; grading: 40 requests / 300 s; at most 32,000 output tokens per request; 2 GiB / 1 CPU / pids 256. Same image and pip TUNA index; new session and home, with generic access configuration retained after audit.
api_request_spacing_instruction: At least one second; stop after two consecutive 403/429/connection failures. These API limits are instructions; model and time limits are enforced.
reference_limits: Maintainer pages were acquired independently before candidate queries; this is independent acquisition, not independent authorship of the underlying vulnerability. Both candidates import common upstream records. Agreement is not independent security discovery.
retention_notice: Controller archived original access config and removed prior package examples, answers and obsolete quota observations. No client code, parsing helper, query answer or reference was added; actual access scripts remained in archived workspaces. This preparation is disclosed, not counted as unassisted config reuse.
comparison: Both business execution outputs were collected and peer snapshots sealed before separate fresh grading sessions; graders received the maintainer reference and peer executions, without other verdicts or credentials.
attribution: GitHub Advisory Database, CC BY 4.0: https://github.com/advisories
PyPA Advisory Database, CC BY 4.0: https://github.com/pypa/advisory-database
Django maintainer announcements linked under official_reference_sources
public_selection: Only identifiers, necessary version facts, request outcomes and hashes are published. Full candidate payloads, advisory descriptions and third-party contributor data remain private.
service_fee_interpretation: This business grader accepted the frozen public-free conditions with observed anonymous calls. Both access graders retained unknown because explicit free-rule applicability was not confirmed to their satisfaction. Preserve the distinct judgments; this is not a price change or evidence that unknown access cost equals zero.
resources: No account, token, signup, payment or mutable service resource created. All four dedicated containers stopped after collection and independent review.
query_strategy: Two direct cve_id filters at GET /advisories; one returned record per alert. No alternative database or web search.
